trans-unit.target: Larim senis bilong spid bilong pilai

trans-unit.source: Select an interaction to view details
trans-unit.target: Makim intaraktiviti bilong lukim ol toksave

trans-unit.source: Invalid time format. Use hh:mm:ss or mm:ss
trans-unit.target: Pasin bilong raitim taim i no stret. Yusim hh:mm:ss o mm:ss

trans-unit.target: I no gat midia i stap yet.
Putim URL bilong vidio o odio

trans-unit.source: Supported services: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, direct video/audio links
trans-unit.target: Ol sevis i wok: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, na ol link bilong vidio/odio

trans-unit.source: YouTube videos only play on a web server
trans-unit.target: YouTube vidio i save pilai long web server tasol

trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: YouTube i save pilai ol vidio insait long ol pes we web server i givim tasol. Em tambu bilong YouTube, i no bilong WebWriter.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Olsem na dispela vidio bai no inap long kamap long WebWriter previu, o long ol dokumen yu opim stret long divais. Bilong ol sumatin i ken lukim, putim dokumen long web server (olsem WebWriter Cloud) na salim link bilong en.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Sapos yu laik tilim dokumen olsem wanpela fail, na i no long web server, yusim narapela ples bilong vidio na lusim YouTube.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: Dispela i no bagarapim ol vidio bilong narapela ples na ol fail bilong vidio o odio yu bin apim.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be read. Please try again or choose a different file.
trans-unit.target: Fail i no inap long rit. Traim gen o makim narapela fail.

trans-unit.source: This file type isn't supported. Please choose an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
trans-unit.target: Dispela kain fail i no wok. Makim MP4 o WebM vidio, o MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC o OGG odio fail.

trans-unit.source: The media player could not be started. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Pilaia midia i no inap stat. Traim gen.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be loaded. It is damaged or isn't a video or audio file.
trans-unit.target: Fail i no inap long kamap. Em i bagarap o em i no fail bilong vidio o odio.

trans-unit.source: Spotify albums and playlists aren't supported. Please use a link to a single track or episode.
trans-unit.target: Ol album na playlist bilong Spotify i no wok. Yusim link bilong wanpela singsing o episod tasol.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken or the file may no longer exist.
trans-unit.target: Midia i no inap kamap. Link i bruk o fail i no stap moa.

trans-unit.source: This link doesn't point to a video or audio file. Please check the link, or use a link to a supported service.
trans-unit.target: Dispela link i no go long fail vidio o odio. Sekim link o yusim link bilong sevis i wok.

trans-unit.source: Loading the media was aborted. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Loding bilong midia i stop. Traim gen.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded because of a network error. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Midia i no inap kamap long wanem netwok i gat rong. Sekim intanet, na traimport gen.

trans-unit.source: The media file is damaged or uses a format your browser cannot play.
trans-unit.target: Fail bilong midia i bagarap o em i gat format we browser i no inap pilai.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken, or the format isn't supported by your browser.
trans-unit.target: Midia i no inap kamap. Link i bruk o browser i no sapotim format.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Midia i no inap kamap. Sekim link na intanet, na traimport gen.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube link is invalid. Please check the link and try again.
trans-unit.target: Dispela link bilong YouTube i no stret. Sekim na traimport gen.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube video doesn't exist or is private.
trans-unit.target: Dispela vidio bilong YouTube i no stap o em i privat.

trans-unit.source: The owner of this YouTube video doesn't allow it to be embedded. Please use a different video.
trans-unit.target: Papa bilong dispela vidio bilong YouTube i no larim yu putim long narapela pes. Yusim narapela vidio.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: YouTube i no pilai dispela vidio long hia, long wanem pes i no tokim YouTube em husat. Dispela i save kamap long WebWriter previu o long dokumen yu opim stret long divais. Putim dokumen long web server (olsem WebWriter Cloud) na opim long hap.

trans-unit.source: The YouTube video could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: YouTube vidio i no inap kamap. Sekim link na intanet, na traimport gen.

trans-unit.source: The Vimeo video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Vimeo vidio i no inap kamap. Ating em i no stap, em i privat, o em i no larim yu putim long narapela pes.

trans-unit.source: The TikTok video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: TikTok vidio i no inap kamap. Ating em i no stap, em i privat, o em i no larim yu putim long narapela pes.

trans-unit.source: The Spotify track could not be loaded. It may not exist or may not be available in your region.
trans-unit.target: Spotify singsing i no inap kamap. Ating em i no stap o i no stap long ples bilong yu.

trans-unit.source: The media took too long to load. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Midia i kisim tumas taim long kamap. Sekim link na intanet, na traimport gen.

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current audio?
trans-unit.target: Yu laik tru long rausim dispela odio?

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current video?
trans-unit.target: Yu laik tru long rausim dispela vidio?

trans-unit.source: Also remove all interactions and chapters
trans-unit.target: Rausim tu olgeta intaraktiviti na hap
Ofim senis bilong spid bilong pilai

trans-unit.source: Remove the current media and keep its interactions and chapters?
trans-unit.target: Rausim midia nau na holim ol intaraktiviti na hap bilong en?
